parameters.formDescription: Something not working right? Tell us in a few words — you don’t need to know any tech words. Just the two questions below, then hit Submit. (Everything under “Optional” you can skip.)

values.fieldLabel: What were you trying to do?

values.option: 🎬 Request a movie, show, or book

values.placeholder: e.g. The TV said ‘not available’ when I pressed play

values.html: Optional — only if you have a second. Skip these and just hit Submit if you’re in a hurry.

values.fieldLabel: Where were you? (which device or room)
values.placeholder: e.g. Living-room TV, my phone, the iPad
e.g. Just now, this morning, every time I try

values.fieldLabel: How much is it bothering you?

values.option: 😕 Annoying — but I can still use it
🛑 Blocking — I can't do it at all
